# SGEN · Med Spa Local SEO and AEO

> SGEN is a local search agency for medical spas and aesthetic clinics. We win map pack and organic positions in Google, and we build clinic websites that ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Claude are willing to quote. Delivered as one monthly retainer starting at $497 a month, with no setup fee and no minimum term.

Two jobs run under a single invoice. The first is placement: where a clinic sits in Google's organic results and in the Maps three-pack for the treatments that carry its margin. The second is inclusion: whether an assistant names that clinic at all when somebody asks where to get treated nearby. Single-room injectable studios through to multi-site aesthetic groups. Stripe bills monthly, nothing is charged to start, and there is nothing to sign.

## Pages
- [Med Spa Local SEO and AEO](https://www.sgen.com/med-spa-local-seo-aeo): the med spa landing page, covering how the work runs, what each tier costs, sample results and the full FAQ.

## Pricing
- Local SEO · $497/month
- Local AEO · $797/month
- SEO + AEO · $1,297/month
Stripe collects the retainer monthly. Cancelling takes two clicks in the customer portal. There is no setup fee, no onboarding charge and no exit fee, and everything already built stays on the clinic's own domain.

## Method
Six stages: audit and entity mapping across 14 AI surfaces; foundation rebuild covering MedicalClinic and HealthAndBeautyBusiness schema, llms.txt, structured client questions, Google Business Profile and Core Web Vitals; a content engine of 8 to 24 treatment pages a month; a citation network spanning local press, RealSelf, Healthgrades, AmSpa and the supplier clinic locators; weekly visibility reporting across Google and the four assistants; then scaling into further locations and treatment lines.

## Treatments served
Injectables including tox and filler, laser hair removal, laser resurfacing and IPL, body contouring, skin tightening by radiofrequency and ultrasound, facials and skin health programmes, medical weight loss, hormone therapy and IV wellness, PRP and hair restoration, and medical-grade skincare.

## Key answers
- How fast does it work? Local ranking movement usually becomes visible in the 60 to 120 day band. Mentions inside ChatGPT, Gemini or Perplexity tend to arrive earlier, often inside the first month or two, because assistants refresh their sources far more often than Google reranks.
- Can the retainer be stopped? Yes. Stripe bills monthly and the clinic cancels itself in the customer portal. There is no retention call and no exit fee. Every page, post, citation and link already built remains live and under the clinic's control.
- What is AEO? Answer Engine Optimization. SEO competes for a position on a results page. AEO decides whether an assistant names the clinic at all in the single answer a client now reads instead of opening anyone's site.
- Is there a contract? None. Month to month, nothing to set up and nothing to sign.
